Recovery Contact vs Recovery Key vs Two-Factor Authentication — hard disambiguation

Apple groups several account-recovery and sign-in options under Sign-In & Security. Indie teams conflate them on one product page. AppLocale covers Recovery Contact trusted-person marketing — not the sibling features:

  • Recovery Contact (this page) — trusted person with an Apple device who can help regain Apple ID access when the password is forgotten; Add Recovery Contact under Settings → Sign-In & Security → Recovery Contacts. Gallery frames may show enrollment sheets, trusted-contact badges, or account-recovery walkthroughs. zh-Hans terms: 恢复联系人, 账号恢复联系人, 添加恢复联系人, 受信任的恢复联系人, 账户恢复.
  • Recovery Key (different) — 28-character alphanumeric code the user generates and stores offline; 恢复密钥 vocabulary — not a human recovery helper. Do not reuse Recovery Key copy when English only markets Recovery Contact enrollment unless your gallery genuinely shows both.
  • Two-Factor Authentication (different) — account-level 2FA with trusted devices and six-digit verification codes during sign-in — 双重认证 vocabulary — not password-forgotten recovery through a nominated contact. See Two-Factor Authentication listing when that is your lead feature.
  • Security Keys (different) — physical FIDO2 hardware under Sign-In & Security → Two-Factor Authentication → Security Keys — 安全密钥 vocabulary — not Recovery Contact nomination. See Security Keys listing when hardware FIDO is your lead.
  • Passkeys & Sign in with Apple (different) — passwordless app login and Continue with Apple badges — separate stories under their own listing pages — not Apple ID Recovery Contact enrollment.

Your gallery may show a Recovery Contact enrollment sheet on one frame and a security dashboard on the next — but listing copy should name each claim accurately per frame. An Add Recovery Contact badge is not a Recovery Key code display, not a Turn On Two-Factor Authentication toggle, and not a Security Key registration flow unless that is what the screenshot shows.

What Apple Recovery Contact actually does — listing honesty

Apple Recovery Contact lets users nominate a trusted person — typically a friend or family member who uses Apple devices — to help them regain Apple ID access if they forget their password and cannot reach trusted devices. The nominated contact receives an invitation and must accept before enrollment completes. Third-party apps may complement this by educating buyers, aligning security UX with account-recovery expectations, or documenting honest enrollment scope. Recovery Contact–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Account-recovery marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Recovery Contact — not a literal paste of US marketing:

恢复联系人 vs 账号恢复联系人

Apple's Chinese system UI uses 恢复联系人 for the Settings toggle under 登录与安全性. Product-page copy may also use 账号恢复联系人 when emphasizing Apple ID account recovery scope. AppLocale picks the term buyers recognize on each screenshot — a Settings walkthrough needs Settings-aligned phrasing; a benefit headline may use 账号恢复联系人 when accurate to your English source.

添加恢复联系人 (Add Recovery Contact)

US pages use "Add Recovery Contact", "Set up a recovery contact", or "Nominate someone you trust." China storefront copy uses 添加恢复联系人 on frames that walk buyers through enrollment — not 添加安全密钥 unless your English source genuinely markets Recovery Key on that frame.

受信任的恢复联系人 (trusted recovery person)

Recovery Contact requires someone the user trusts who already uses Apple devices. zh-Hans marketing uses 受信任的恢复联系人 or 你信任的人 when describing who can help — not 受信设备 (trusted device for 2FA sign-in) unless your English source genuinely markets both on the same frame.

账户恢复 (account recovery)

When screenshots explain what happens if the user forgets their Apple ID password, listing copy may reference 账户恢复 or 找回 Apple ID — account recovery flows tied to Recovery Contact enrollment. Screenshot captions that walk buyers to the toggle should use the Chinese settings path buyers see on device — not Face ID & Passcode like Stolen Device Protection, and not iCloud like Advanced Data Protection.

AppLocale FAQ

What is Apple Recovery Contact?

Recovery Contact is under Settings → [your name] → Sign-In & Security → Recovery Contacts. Users nominate a trusted person with an Apple device who can help them regain Apple ID access if they forget their password and lose trusted devices. Marketing that awareness on your en-US page does not auto-fill zh-Hans Connect fields.

Does mentioning Recovery Contact auto-translate my China listing?

No. Recovery Contact is a system Apple Account setting on the buyer's account — it does not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback on the product page.
